definitions.explanation: The period of life roughly between 40 and 60, or a person in that age range. Can be used as a noun or as a modifier.

examples.japanese: {中年|ちゅうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話|はな}しかけて→話しかける：03134_hanashikakeru⟧きた。
examples.english: A middle-aged man spoke to me.

examples.japanese: {中年|ちゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衰|おとろ}え→衰え：20068_otoroe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: When you reach middle age, you start to feel a decline in stamina.

examples.japanese: {中年|ちゅうねん}{太|ぶと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にして→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧、⟦ジョギング→ジョギング：04738_jogingu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Worried about middle-age weight gain, I started jogging.

notes:
{中年|ちゅうねん} refers to the middle years of adulthood, typically around 40 to 60.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中年|ちゅうねん}⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧/⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧ (middle-aged man/woman)
- {中年|ちゅうねん}{太|ぶと}り (middle-age weight gain)
- {中年|ちゅうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧ (midlife crisis)
- {中年|ちゅうねん}⟦{以降|いこう}→以降：03999_ikou⟧ (from middle age onward)

AGE STAGES:
- ⟦{青年|せいねん}→青年：03292_seinen⟧ (young adult, roughly 15-30)
- {中年|ちゅうねん} (middle-aged, roughly 40-60)
- ⟦{老年|ろうねん}→老年：14072_rounen⟧/⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧ (elderly, roughly 65+)
